description: A deterministic, leakage-safe soft-voting ensemble. Median imputation with missingness indicators is fitted separately inside each training fold; scale-sensitive models also use robust scaling. The ensemble combines extremely randomized trees, balanced random forests, regularized histogram gradient boosting, RBF SVM, and logistic regression. Two repetitions of stratified 5-fold cross-validation produce out-of-fold probabilities for selecting a stable equal-weight model subset and a macro-F1 decision threshold. Test probabilities are averaged across the corresponding cross-fitted models, so every preprocessing operation is learned from training rows only.
